meta.description: Machine-readable design system for Studio Harmon. CSS variables live on :root in src/styles/global.css — reference the token, never the raw hex.

--ink.role: Primary text, dark panels, ink buttons

accentHighlight.note: Wrap one or two words in <em> with .mark-clay (font-style:normal; color:var(--clay))

motion.note: Restrained only. One subtle marquee on the home services bar. No looping/decorative animation.

buttons.base: inline-flex; gap:9px; font-weight:700; font-size:15px; padding:14px 24px; radius:8px; optional trailing .arr

principles: One clay accent — no second hue, no gradients.
Friendly, plain-spoken voice. Lead with the customer benefit.
Generous whitespace, hairline borders, big type.

componentPatterns.hero: Eyebrow + clamp display H1 with clay-marked words + sub paragraph + CTA row, followed by full-bleed ink marquee. Ref: index.astro
componentPatterns.work-grid: 1.3fr/1fr grid: one tall feature card + two stacked. Card = image placeholder + body row (name, tag, clay stat). Hover lifts + clay border. Ref: index.astro #work
componentPatterns.dark-panel: Ink rounded panel (radius 28px) with clay eyebrow + H2 + numbered steps with clay pills. Ref: index.astro #how
componentPatterns.services-list: Bordered rows grid 46px/1.1fr/1.4fr/auto: index, title, description, clay icon. Rows indent + go --white on hover. Ref: index.astro #services
componentPatterns.metrics: Three --white cards with large clay Bricolage number + label. Ref: index.astro metrics
componentPatterns.pricing: Two-column grid; featured card inverts to ink. Ref: index.astro #pricing
componentPatterns.cta-banner: Full clay rounded banner, centered H2 + button row. Ref: index.astro CTA
componentPatterns.split-form: 0.85fr/1.15fr two-column: left lede + steps/facts, right --white card. Collapses at 900px. Ref: start.astro, book.astro
